summary: Added template discovery and insertion to the VSCode extension. Created TemplateCommandHandler (commands/template-commands.ts) that registers three insert commands and a quick pick browser. Created TemplateQuickPickProvider (providers/template-provider.ts) showing templates with descriptions and parameter counts. Added VSCode snippets (snippets/templates.json) with trigger keywords invoice, pdf-convert, and contract-summary. Updated extension.ts to import and register the template handler, and updated package.json with command palette entries, activation events, menu visibility rules, and snippet contribution.
